seeds.name: Air Bass
seeds.silent: plucks need the fretting hand and an enrolled pluck; the synthetic hands do not play it

seeds.name: Air Guitar
seeds.silent: strums need two hands and enrolled chord shapes; the synthetic hands enrol none

seeds.name: Air Flute
seeds.silent: notes need enrolled finger lifts and a blowing mouth; nothing is enrolled

seeds.name: Play Along (MIDI)
seeds.silent: a MIDI keyboard chooses the chord; the smoke has none (midi.smoke.ts plays one into it)

seeds.name: Play Along (microphone)
seeds.silent: listens to the microphone; the smoke has no audio input

seeds.name: Face Wheel
seeds.silent: the face steers it, and there is no synthetic face

seeds.name: Conduct the Chords (Body)
seeds.silent: waits for the first beat; the synthetic body does not conduct

seeds.name: Sign Wheel
seeds.silent: a chord sounds only after a letter A..G is read, which the synthetic hands do only by chance

seeds.name: Sign Map
seeds.silent: a chord lights only after a letter A..G is read, which the synthetic hands do only by chance

seeds.name: Chord Map Strum
seeds.silent: strums on the second hand, which the synthetic source does not show (one hand reads chords and strums nothing)

seeds.name: ASL Viewer
seeds.silent: reads signs from the hands; the synthetic hands sign nothing

seeds.name: ASL Chords
seeds.silent: plays a chord per recognised sign; the synthetic hands sign nothing

seeds.name: Drawn Pieces
seeds.silent: starts with no pieces; it sounds only once a shape is drawn and struck
